name: talos/acris-bigquery
what_it_holds: Scripts to pull the same NYC ACRIS dataset from NYC Open Data and load it into BigQuery for faster querying (no rows committed to repo).
why_useful: Same ACRIS/LLC-ownership use case as acris-download but at BigQuery scale, useful if the team wants to run entity-name matching (LLC clustering) across the full ACRIS history without local DB setup.

name: clhenrick/nyc-property-extractor
what_it_holds: Node.js app providing a map-based interface to query NYC's MapPLUTO (parcel/zoning/building attributes) and ACRIS (transaction) datasets together.
why_useful: Combines the two datasets the theme keyword hints named explicitly (PLUTO + ACRIS); useful as a reference implementation for joining parcel characteristics to ownership-transfer records for STR-supply analysis in NYC.
size_hint: app code, queries live NYC Open Data/Socrata endpoints, no bulk data committed
time_coverage: current PLUTO/ACRIS vintages as of last update (2020)

name: ryansherby/RedfinScraper
what_it_holds: Actively maintained (100 stars, updated 2 Sep 2026) Python library that calls Redfin's unofficial 'Stingray' API to bulk-pull for-sale listings and sold-home records (configurable 1mo-5yr sold windows) by zip code. No data committed; requires user-supplied zip list. README explicitly warns of Redfin IP-ban risk for misuse.
why_useful: Most substantial Redfin access tool found; could be adapted to build a for-sale/sold-inventory and price time series (a housing-supply proxy for STR host economics) in markets Airbnb over-indexes on, though it does not natively flag investor/LLC buyers.
size_hint: code only; scrape volume limited by Redfin's own rate limits
time_coverage: current + trailing 1mo-5yr sold windows at scrape time (not historical archive)
themes: Housing supply and investor activity: building permits, Redfin investor purchases, mortgage rates, county assessor/parcel data, LLC ownership, NYC PLUTO/ACRIS
why_all: Most substantial Redfin access tool found; could be adapted to build a for-sale/sold-inventory and price time series (a housing-supply proxy for STR host economics) in markets Airbnb over-indexes on, though it does not natively flag investor/LLC buyers.

name: cfpb/hmda-platform
what_it_holds: CFPB's official regulatory-technology platform for Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) filings: parses/validates pipe-delimited Transmission (TS) and Loan Application Register (LAR) files, and exposes filing APIs, a data browser, analytics dashboards and a rate-spread calculator with documented REST endpoints for pulling loan-level mortgage origination data (loan amount, rate spread, applicant/property geography, action taken) nationwide. 11,916 commits, CC0-1.0 (public domain).
why_useful: HMDA is the authoritative, free, loan-level US mortgage-origination dataset (rates, loan amounts, geography, applicant/property type) back to the 1970s at aggregate level and ~2007+ at loan level via the modern platform — a genuine free mortgage-rate/lending-volume source for the housing-supply/investor-purchase thread (mortgage rates + county-level lending activity), reachable via the linked Data Browser/S3 dumps rather than this repo's own commits.
size_hint: platform source code only in this repo; external HMDA public LAR datasets run into tens of millions of loan records per year
time_coverage: modern HMDA platform ~2017-present; HMDA aggregate data back to 1975 via Data Browser
themes: Housing supply and investor activity: building permits, Redfin investor purchases, mortgage rates, county assessor/parcel data, LLC ownership, NYC PLUTO/ACRIS
why_all: HMDA is the authoritative, free, loan-level US mortgage-origination dataset (rates, loan amounts, geography, applicant/property type) back to the 1970s at aggregate level and ~2007+ at loan level via the modern platform — a genuine free mortgage-rate/lending-volume source for the housing-supply/investor-purchase thread (mortgage rates + county-level lending activity), reachable via the linked Data Browser/S3 dumps rather than this repo's own commits.

Provides a maintained, documented method to pull nationwide loan-level mortgage rate/origination data by county/tract and year -- directly useful for a mortgage-rate and housing-finance-conditions series feeding the host-supply-economics work in gap 13; CC0 licensing removes any reuse friction.

name: mcp-atlas
what_it_holds: MCP server (npm package @urbankitstudio/mcp-atlas) providing a uniform query interface over ~137-155 US county parcel ArcGIS REST endpoints; tools for owner/taxpayer name lookup (case-insensitive partial match, useful for identifying LLC-named owners), APN lookup, and site/mailing address retrieval. MIT license, 13 commits, 2026 copyright.
why_useful: A ready-made client for pulling county assessor/parcel-owner records (including LLC-style owner names) across a large multi-state county set without hand-building per-county ArcGIS queries -- directly on-theme for 'county assessor/parcel data' and 'LLC ownership'.
time_coverage: current parcel-roll snapshot (live query, not historical)
size_hint: 13 commits, thin wrapper -- no committed dataset, live API pass-through
